mapper.insert: INSERT INTO collection_request (loan_account_id, repayment_channel_id, collection_request_status_id, send_date, telegram_no, sent_at, withdrawal_bank_code, withdrawal_account_no, amount, next_retry_at) VALUES (#{loanAccountId}, #{repaymentChannelId}, #{collectionRequestStatusId}, #{sendDate}, #{telegramNo}, #{sentAt}, #{withdrawalBankCode}, #{withdrawalAccountNo}, #{amount}, #{nextRetryAt})
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM collection_request WHERE loan_account_id = #{loanAccountId} AND collection_request_status_id IN (#{requested}, #{collected}))

SELECT collection_request_id, loan_account_id, repayment_channel_id, collection_request_status_id, send_date, telegram_no, sent_at, withdrawal_bank_code, withdrawal_account_no, amount, retry_count, next_retry_at FROM collection_request WHERE collection_request_status_id IN (#{requested}, #{collected}) AND next_retry_at <= #{now} ORDER BY next_retry_at, collection_request_id
